title: OrderMoE: An expert similarity driven distributed edge MoE inference
abstract: arXiv:2607.17154v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Although mixture-of-experts, MoE, models have been increasingly adopted to scale large language models with moderate computation cost, it remains challenging to deploy MoE inference over resource-constrained and bandwidth-limited edge infrastructures. Existing distributed MoE serving methods mainly rely on exact expert placement, caching, replication, or communication scheduling, while overlooking the functional similarity among experts, which provides an opportunity to reduce cross-server token transmission. Therefore, this paper introduces a similarity-aware expert allocation and distributed deployment framework, dubbed OrderMoE, which aims to accelerate edge MoE inference while balancing inference latency, communication overhead, server workload, and inference quality. translated_title: OrderMoE：一种基于专家相似度驱动的分布式边缘MoE推理方法
translated_abstract: 尽管混合专家（MoE）模型因其适中的计算成本而被越来越多地用于扩展大型语言模型，但在资源受限和带宽有限的边缘基础设施上部署MoE推理仍然具有挑战性。现有的分布式MoE服务方法主要依赖于精确的专家放置、缓存、复制或通信调度，而忽视了专家之间的功能相似性，这为减少跨服务器令牌传输提供了机会。因此，本文引入了一种基于相似性感知的专家分配和分布式部署框架，称为OrderMoE，旨在加速边缘MoE推理，同时平衡推理延迟、通信开销、服务器负载和推理质量。OrderMoE首先基于路由器诱导的logits表示构建专家相似性模型，并将每个MoE层中的专家划分为多个相似组。
tldr: OrderMoE通过利用专家间的功能相似性，提出了一种相似性感知的专家分配和分布式部署框架，以在边缘环境中加速MoE推理并平衡延迟、通信、负载和质量。
en_tdlr: OrderMoE leverages functional similarity among experts to propose a similarity-aware expert allocation and distributed deployment framework, accelerating edge MoE inference while balancing latency, communication, load, and quality.
